basis: Neuromuscular junction defect; muscle fiber atrophy and fixed joint abnormalities reported in 30-79%. Respiratory and bulbar weakness do not establish lung or GI tissue damage.
Inherited recurrent encephalopathy with prominent movement and tone abnormalities; joint hypermobility alone does not establish musculoskeletal damage.
Inherited rod-cone retinal degeneration. Hepatic fibrosis and cardiovascular abnormalities occur in only 1/6 patients, below 30%.
Defining motor and speech developmental delay with hypotonia. Small hands and feet do not establish locomotor dysfunction; cardiac and endocrine abnormalities are occasional.
Defined by developmental brain malformations with associated urinary tract malformations; vesicoureteral reflux is frequent (30-79%).
CNKSR2-related intellectual disability, language impairment and epilepsy. Isolated small-sample reports of joint hypermobility or nystagmus do not establish additional organ damage.
Congenital vascular malformations with defining bone hypoplasia, muscle hypotrophy and limb deformity.
Inherited coagulation abnormality defined by excess factor V activity and spontaneous vascular thrombosis. Pulmonary embolism does not establish intrinsic lung disease.
Glandular neoplasm arising in urinary bladder; intestinal resemblance does not indicate gastrointestinal involvement.
Isolated spermatogenic failure affects reproductive function; endocrine gland dysfunction is not established.
Pineal parenchymal neuroepithelial CNS tumor; endocrine dysfunction is not a defining feature.
Familial Behcet-like autoinflammation is characterized by recurrent oral mucosal ulceration. Additional damaging skin, ocular or vascular disease is not established across subtypes.
GNAO1-related neurodevelopmental disorder with intellectual disability, movement disorder, seizures and structural brain abnormalities.
Labels reflect defining cutaneous melanoma and glioma susceptibility, not established tumors or existing organ damage. Other potential tumor sites are risks only.
Primary structural skeletal myopathy. Respiratory, bulbar and extraocular weakness arise from affected skeletal muscles; intrinsic lung, GI or ocular damage is not established.
Folate metabolic disorder with combined immunodeficiency and megaloblastic anemia. Intellectual disability, seizures and hippocampal hypoplasia reported in 1/1 assessed patients; evidence is sparse.
Inherited thyroid hormone resistance affecting peripheral hormone responsiveness; no additional direct organ damage is established.
Benign pulmonary pneumocytoma arising from lung epithelial cells; historical hemangioma terminology does not establish vascular origin.
Elevated intraocular pressure is an eye disorder, not systemic vascular hypertension. Subsequent glaucoma is a separate disease.
Defined by platelet storage-pool dysfunction and oculocutaneous albinism with reduced vision. Pulmonary fibrosis and colitis are uncommon in HPS3.
Krebs-cycle metabolic defect with defining neurodevelopmental disease; skeletal muscle atrophy occurs in 80-99%. Hepatomegaly and salivary morphology alone do not establish functional damage.
Progressive cavitating white-matter disease with neurological deficits and deterioration; no additional organ involvement established.
Hyperkeratotic lesion confined to uterine cervical mucosa, a reproductive site outside the axes.
Congenital structural thumb deformity. Nonspecific nervous-system annotation without a defined lesion or frequency does not establish neurologic involvement.
Umbrella for inherited steroid metabolism defects. Hepatic, vascular and other damage varies by subtype and is not established across most patients.
